basis: Explicit accounting scenario for the two unquoted rights in the frozen WFO; not recovered market data or realized liquidation.
cash_consideration: recognize as receivable at face value on mandatory conversion
subsequent_claim_accounting: The scenario makes the full conservative charge at conversion and books no later claim-related gains or losses. It excludes any subsequent payouts, financing, reserve releases and fair-value changes. The separate claim register retains the long rights and short obligations; no sale of a non-transferable right is assumed.
sensitivity: All four combinations of zero/contractual-maximum marks for ABMD and WBA. These isolate the two event-mark assumptions, holding subsequent claim P&L at zero in every combination. They are not bounds on actual wealth with later claim cash flows.
scope: Only the two unresolved merger valuations, across all six strategies. Original observed/recovered returns, positions, cohorts, forecasts, features and fitted models stay unchanged.
